svg.title: The section recovers each translated copy and its scale normalization; its support addresses retain the exterior-spectator condition. Taking the same absolute-value root therefore gives the identical zero seminorm. For the chart step, retain the inverses in their stated order: yi = P −1 i Z−1 i xi and ZiPiyi = xi.
